title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
title_zh: 为多智能体系统重塑企业 RAG：一种先组织后检索的知识层

paragraphs.en: Enterprise organizations are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and these agents need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on rather than documentation written for stakeholders. Recent work has shown that this logic can be recovered at scale: a seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline of our own design processed 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, business rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery, however, does not confer usability. Business entities recur throughout such an estate under a shared vocabulary: offer , eligibility , and activation each govern rules in several services, related in name but operationally distinct, so an end-to-end journey implicates well over a thousand rules whose text is near-identical across contexts that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails here in its most consequential form, returning a structurally identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity and with no signal of error. Content-level ontology is the traditional remedy, but none existed, and relating every occurrence of every recurring entity to every other would have yielded a graph whose construction cost exceeded the engagement and whose currency would not survive a release cycle. We place the ontology at the artifact level instead. Because the corpus is machine-generated, each artifact retains its producer, component, service, domain and type, provenance sufficient to disambiguate before any content is read. We present a knowledge layer that organizes before it retrieves : a self-describing catalog, a sparse metadata registry, and a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities. Queries resolve to a set of artifact identifiers to which vector search is then constrained, so the competing rule from another service is absent from the candidate set rather than outranked within it, and disambiguation becomes structural rather than statistical. Constructed in under a week and admitting new services by convention, the layer serves production SDLC agents alongside developers, quality engineers and analysts querying it directly. We report more than 100 production defects for which it supported root-cause analysis and resolution under developer verification, and 35 release regression failures attributed to specific rules and services.
paragraphs.zh: 企业组织正在软件开发生命周期中部署智能体式 AI，而这些智能体需要的是其所作用系统的行为逻辑，而非为利益相关者编写的文档。 近期工作表明，这种逻辑可以大规模恢复：我们自主设计的七智能体逆向工程流水线处理了 18 个服务下的 241 个代码库，生成了数千个描述范围、旅程、业务规则和验收标准的产物。 然而，恢复本身并不等于可用性。 业务实体在这样一个系统中以共享词汇反复出现：offer、eligibility 和 activation 各自在多个服务中治理规则，它们名称相关但在运营上彼此独立，因此一条端到端旅程会牵涉上千条规则，其文本在不同上下文中几乎完全相同，而这些上下文绝不能被混淆。 平面向量检索在此以最具危害性的方式失效：以高相似度返回来自错误服务的一条结构上完全相同的规则，且没有任何错误信号。 内容级本体是传统补救手段，但此处并不存在，而将每个重复实体的每次出现都相互关联会产出一个构建成本超过整个项目的图，且其时效性也撑不过一个发布周期。 我们转而将本体放在产物层面。 由于语料是机器生成的，每个产物都保留了其生产者、组件、服务、领域和类型，这一溯源信息在任何内容被读取之前就足以完成消歧。 我们提出一个先组织后检索的知识层：一个自描述目录、一个稀疏元数据注册表，以及一个定义在产物而非抽取实体之上的导航超图。 查询解析为一组产物标识符，向量检索随后被约束在该集合之内，因此来自其他服务的竞争规则是根本不在候选集合中，而不是在集合内排名靠后，消歧由此从统计层面变为结构层面。 该层在一周内构建完成，并可按约定接纳新服务，它在为生产环境 SDLC 智能体服务的同时，也支持开发者、质量工程师和分析师直接查询。 我们报告了一百多个生产缺陷，在开发者验证下该知识层支持了这些缺陷的根因分析与解决，以及 35 次可归因于特定规则和服务的发布回归失败。

paragraphs.en: Enterprise software organizations are moving from using AI as a tool to deploying it as an organizational capability. Across the software development lifecycle, specialized agents now recover undocumented business logic, generate tests from behavioral specifications, triage production defects against requirements, assess merge-request risk, and attribute release failures to rule violations. Each reasons from a distinct professional standpoint, and each requires knowledge of the application at a level of detail that stakeholder documentation does not supply: the behavioral logic embedded in source code, configuration, and tests. Prior work has established that this logic can be recovered at scale ( Agrawal et al. 2026a ; Agrawal et al. 2024 ) . Applying a seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline of our own design to the estate reported here, we processed 241 repositories across 18 services into several thousand structured artifacts spanning scope definitions, user journeys, business rules, acceptance criteria, and gap registers, each finding carrying a reference to its source. The behavioral specification of the estate, which had never been written, thereby came into existence as structured data.
paragraphs.zh: 企业软件组织正在将 AI 从一种工具转变为一种组织能力进行部署。 在整个软件开发生命周期中，各类专用智能体现在能够恢复未文档化的业务逻辑、根据行为规范生成测试、对照需求对生产缺陷进行分类、评估合并请求风险，并将发布失败归因于违反规则的行为。 每个智能体都从不同的专业视角进行推理，并且每个智能体都需要对应用程序有利益相关方文档所不能提供的细节层面的了解：即嵌入在源代码、配置和测试中的行为逻辑。 已有先行工作证实，这种逻辑可以被大规模地恢复（Agrawal et al. 2026a；Agrawal et al. 2024）。 将我们自己设计的七智能体逆向工程流水线应用于本文所述的系统资产，我们处理了横跨 18 个服务的 241 个代码仓库，生成了数千个结构化工件，涵盖范围定义、用户旅程、业务规则、验收标准和差距登记册，每项发现都附带对其来源的引用。 从未被编写过的系统资产行为规范，由此以结构化数据的形式得以形成。

paragraphs.en: The Organization Problem. The estate is orchestrated through 14 business process workflows. A single workflow may invoke as many as 112 endpoint-level requirements documents in one execution, and an end-to-end journey such as order placement, order submission, or customer update implicates well over a thousand business rules. Volume alone would be manageable. The compounding difficulty is that the estate’s business vocabulary is shared across the services that compose it. Terms such as offer , eligibility , activation , order , and provisioning recur throughout, denoting related but non-interchangeable concepts: offer governs eligibility rules in the ordering service, definition and validity rules in catalog, and discount rules in billing. The artifacts describing them consequently exhibit substantial textual overlap while remaining operationally distinct.
paragraphs.zh: 组织问题。 该资产体系通过 14 条业务流程工作流进行编排。 单条工作流在一次执行中可能调用多达 112 份端点级需求文档，而诸如下单、订单提交或客户更新这样的端到端旅程，牵涉的业务规则远超一千条。 仅就规模而言，尚可应对。 真正加剧难度的是，该资产体系的业务词汇在其组成的各服务之间是共享的。 诸如 offer（报价）、eligibility（资格）、activation（激活）、order（订单）和 provisioning（开通）等术语贯穿始终，表示相关但不可互换的概念：offer 在订购服务中支配资格规则，在目录服务中支配定义与有效期规则，在计费服务中支配折扣规则。 因此，描述这些概念的文档在文本上高度重叠，但在运营层面却各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Why Retrieval Alone Is Not Enough. Embedding a corpus into a vector store and retrieving by cosine similarity presumes that proximity in embedding space corresponds to operational relevance. Vocabulary collision inverts that presumption: the highest-ranked result is frequently drawn from the wrong operational context. What distinguishes this failure from ordinary retrieval error is that it leaves no trace. The returned text is well-formed and topically correct, the similarity score is high, and the consuming agent proceeds to reason over it without any indication that its evidence is misattributed.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么仅靠检索还不够。 将语料库嵌入向量存储并通过余弦相似度进行检索，其前提是嵌入空间中的邻近性对应于操作层面的相关性。 词汇碰撞颠倒了这一前提：排名最高的结果往往来自错误的操作上下文。 这种失败与普通检索错误的区别在于，它不会留下任何痕迹。 返回的文本格式规范、主题正确，相似度得分很高，消费它的智能体会直接基于它进行推理，而没有任何迹象表明其证据被错误归属了。

paragraphs.en: Content-level ontology is the established corrective: extract entities, declare relations, and align vocabularies across the estate ( Gruber 1993 ; Noy and Musen 2000 ) . Two considerations made it impracticable here. The first is combinatorial. Each recurring entity appears in several services and relates to every other entity it transacts with, so the graph an ontology would have to construct and keep consistent grows with the product of those occurrences rather than with the number of terms; across a rule population of this size, the alignment effort would constitute the greater part of the engagement rather than a preparatory step. The second is currency. Rules are revised on a release cadence, so an ontology delivered after months of specialist effort would describe a system that had already moved, while the agents depending on it required knowledge of the system as deployed.
paragraphs.zh: 内容层面的本体论是公认的纠偏手段：抽取实体、声明关系，并在整个体系中统一词汇表（Gruber 1993；Noy and Musen 2000）。 有两个因素使得这一做法在本文中不可行。 第一个是组合爆炸。 每个反复出现的实体都会出现在多个服务中，并与其发生交互的每一个其他实体相关联，因此本体论所需构建并保持一致的图会随这些出现次数的乘积而非词条数量增长；在如此规模的规则群体中，对齐工作将占据整个项目的主要部分，而非一个准备性步骤。第二个是时效性。 规则按发布节奏不断修订，因此耗费数月专家精力交付的本体论所描述的将是一个早已变化的系统，而依赖它的智能体需要的是实际部署系统的知识。

sents.en: Two considerations made it impracticable here.
sents.zh: 有两个因素使得这一做法在本文中不可行。

sents.en: The first is combinatorial.
sents.zh: 第一个是组合爆炸。

sents.en: Each recurring entity appears in several services and relates to every other entity it transacts with, so the graph an ontology would have to construct and keep consistent grows with the product of those occurrences rather than with the number of terms; across a rule population of this size, the alignment effort would constitute the greater part of the engagement rather than a preparatory step. The second is currency.
sents.zh: 每个反复出现的实体都会出现在多个服务中，并与其发生交互的每一个其他实体相关联，因此本体论所需构建并保持一致的图会随这些出现次数的乘积而非词条数量增长；在如此规模的规则群体中，对齐工作将占据整个项目的主要部分，而非一个准备性步骤。第二个是时效性。

sents.en: Rules are revised on a release cadence, so an ontology delivered after months of specialist effort would describe a system that had already moved, while the agents depending on it required knowledge of the system as deployed.
sents.zh: 规则按发布节奏不断修订，因此耗费数月专家精力交付的本体论所描述的将是一个早已变化的系统，而依赖它的智能体需要的是实际部署系统的知识。

paragraphs.en: Graph-based retrieval ( Edge et al. 2024 ; Guo et al. 2025 ) induces an entity graph from corpus text and traverses it at query time, with demonstrated benefits for multi-hop reasoning. A graph induced from colliding text, however, inherits the collision: the extractor must determine whether two occurrences of offer constitute one node or two, which relocates the disambiguation problem to the construction phase rather than eliminating it. Each of these approaches treats the corpus as opaque text whose organizing structure must be reconstructed from content. That premise does not hold for a machine-generated corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的检索（Edge et al. 2024；Guo et al. 2025）从语料文本中构建实体图，并在查询时对其进行遍历，在多跳推理方面已展现出明显优势。 然而，由碰撞文本构建的图会继承这种碰撞：抽取器必须判断 offer 的两次出现是构成一个节点还是两个节点，这只是把消歧问题转移到了构建阶段，而非将其消除。 这些方法都把语料视为不透明文本，其组织结构需要从内容中重新构建。 这一前提对于机器生成的语料并不成立。

paragraphs.en: Organize Before You Retrieve. The corpus under consideration possesses a property that distinguishes it from the document collections retrieval systems are typically designed for. Each artifact was emitted by a known producing agent, for a known component, within a known service and domain, under a declared type, with per-finding references to source. The structure required for disambiguation was therefore never latent in content. It was available at the artifact layer, in the circumstances of production, naming, and relation, prior to any content being read.
paragraphs.zh: 先组织，后检索。 所考察的语料库具有一种特性，使它有别于检索系统通常面向的文档集合。 每个工件都由一个已知的智能体产出，服务于已知的组件，归属于已知的服务与领域，具有已声明的类型，并对每项发现附有对来源的引用。 因此，用于消歧所需的结构从来不是潜伏在内容之中的。 它在工件层就可获得，存在于生产、命名与关联的情形之中，早于任何内容被读取之前。

paragraphs.en: Our response was not to forgo ontology but to relocate it to a level the organization can sustain, imposing structure over the artifacts rather than over the entities they contain. We term this approach KB Cataloging , after the apparatus by which a library renders most of its holdings irrelevant to a given inquiry before any volume is opened: a classification scheme, a catalog, and an index, none of which requires reading the collection to construct.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的回应不是放弃本体论，而是将其重新定位到组织能够维持的层面，把结构施加于制品之上，而非施加于其所包含的实体之上。 我们将这一方法称为「知识库编目」（KB Cataloging），其名源自图书馆的一套机制：在打开任何一卷书之前，图书馆便借助分类方案、目录和索引，使馆藏中的大部分内容与特定查询无关，而这三者均无需阅读馆藏即可构建。

paragraphs.en: The mechanism this yields at query time is the framework’s principal contribution. Intent classification and the catalog resolve an incoming question to a set of artifact identifiers, and the vector query is constrained to that set (Section Design: The KB Cataloging Framework ). The competing rule from an adjacent service does not participate in the similarity computation at all, and disambiguation is accordingly effected by the organization of the corpus rather than by the distribution of its scores.
paragraphs.zh: 由此在查询时形成的机制是该框架最主要的贡献。 意图分类与目录将传入的问题解析为一组制品标识符，并将向量查询限定在该集合内（参见章节 设计：知识库目录化框架 ）。 来自相邻服务的竞争性规则完全不参与相似度计算，因此消歧是通过语料库的组织方式实现的，而非通过其分数的分布实现。

paragraphs.en: Artifact-level ontology as a design principle for enterprise knowledge layers serving multi-agent SDLC systems, with the conditions under which organizing artifacts substitutes for modeling their contents stated explicitly (Section Design: The KB Cataloging Framework ) and the boundary of that substitution stated as a limitation (Section Limitations, Path Forward, and Conclusion ).
paragraphs.zh: 面向多智能体 SDLC 系统的企业知识层，以制品级本体作为设计原则，并明确陈述了以制品组织替代对其内容建模的条件（见「Design: The KB Cataloging Framework」一节），以及将这种替代的边界作为局限性加以陈述（见「Limitations, Path Forward, and Conclusion」一节）。

paragraphs.en: A four-component knowledge layer comprising a self-describing artifact catalog, a sparse metadata registry, a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities, and identifier-constrained retrieval with a confidence gate and runtime context graphs. It was constructed in under a week, admits new services by convention rather than schema revision, and refines its own metadata from every query through write-back.
paragraphs.zh: 一个由四部分组成的知识层，包括自描述工件目录、稀疏元数据注册表、定义在工件而非抽取实体之上的导航超图，以及带置信度门控与运行时上下文图的、受标识符约束的检索。 它在一周内构建完成，通过约定而非模式修订即可接入新服务，并通过写回机制从每一次查询中精炼自身元数据。

paragraphs.en: Role-aware knowledge composition , whereby SDLC agents with differing professional concerns, together with developers, quality engineers, and analysts, enter a single structure at the granularity their task requires, constituting a knowledge-serving layer rather than a search index.

paragraphs.en: Deployment evidence (Section Deployment and Evaluation ) from production use: more than 100 defects drawn from the live defect queue for which the layer supported root-cause analysis and resolution under owning-developer verification, 35 release regression failures attributed to specific rules and services, several further agent consumers, and direct querying by practitioners.
paragraphs.zh: 来自生产环境使用的部署证据（第 "部署与评估" 节）：超过 100 个来自实时缺陷队列的缺陷，智能体层在负责开发者的验证下支持了对这些缺陷的根因分析与解决；35 次发布回归失败被归因于特定的规则与服务；另有若干智能体消费者以及从业者的直接查询。

paragraphs.en: An account of the design decisions and boundary conditions that shaped the framework, together with the trajectory from the deployed catalog to a fuller knowledge-serving layer (Section Limitations, Path Forward, and Conclusion ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节阐述了塑造该框架的设计决策与边界条件，并展示了从已部署的目录迈向更完整的知识服务层的发展路径（第 节「局限性」、第 节「未来方向」以及第 节「结论」）。

paragraphs.en: The design proceeds from a single organizing principle: every decision that can be settled at ingestion time is settled there, so that query time incurs only the cost of what remains. Classification, placement, relationship discovery, and metadata capture are performed once, when an artifact enters the system. Retrieval thereafter navigates a pre-organized structure rather than reasoning over unstructured content.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计源于单一的组织原则：凡是能够在摄取时确定的决定都在该阶段确定，从而使查询时只需承担剩余部分的代价。 分类、放置、关系发现和元数据捕获都在工件进入系统时执行一次。 此后的检索只需在一个预先组织好的结构中进行导航，而无需对非结构化内容进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 traces the lifecycle of a unit of knowledge through the system. At ingestion , an upstream agent emits structured artifacts as JSON with provenance intact, and the knowledge layer renames, registers, places, and writes each one, updating three representations in synchrony: the artifact store, the metadata registry, and the navigation hypergraph. At query time, intent classification and the hypergraph reduce a question to a set of artifact identifiers, the vector query is constrained to that set, and a confidence gate determines whether the scoped evidence is sufficient. Through write-back , each query records which artifacts were retrieved, for which task, and to what effect, so that the registry accrues a usage profile rather than remaining static.
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了一个知识单元在系统中经历的生命周期。 在摄取阶段，上游智能体以JSON形式发出保留来源信息的结构化产物，知识层对每个产物进行重命名、注册、定位和写入，并同步更新三种表示：产物存储库、元数据注册表和导航超图。 在查询阶段，意图分类和超图将问题缩减为一组产物标识符，向量查询被限制在该集合内，并由置信度门控判断限定范围的证据是否充分。 通过回写，每次查询都会记录检索了哪些产物、用于哪项任务、产生了什么效果，从而使注册表积累使用档案，而非保持静态。

paragraphs.en: Artifact Catalog and Placement: Cataloging proceeds in four deterministic steps. An artifact arriving from the producing agent is (1) renamed to the convention {service}_{domain}_{feature}_{artifact_type}_v{version}.{ext} , so that its name alone conveys its classification; (2) registered , with an identifier and the metadata its producer already carries; (3) placed into the hypergraph node for its service, domain, and feature, creating that node if it does not exist; and (4) written to a folder hierarchy mirroring the graph, so that the machine-readable store, the registry, and the navigation structure remain in correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: 产物目录与放置：编目过程按四个确定性步骤进行。 来自生产智能体的产物会：(1) 按照约定 {service}_{domain}_{feature}_{artifact_type}_v{version}.{ext} 重命名，使其名称本身即传达其分类；(2) 进行注册，赋予标识符并保留其生产者已携带的元数据；(3) 被放入对应其服务、领域和功能的超图节点中，若该节点不存在则创建之；以及 (4) 写入与图结构镜像对应的文件夹层级，从而保持机器可读存储、注册表和导航结构三者之间的一致对应。

paragraphs.en: Metadata Registry: Sparse, Evolving, Learning: The registry holds one record per artifact across two tiers, shown in Table 1 . Fields known at creation are deterministic and arrive with the artifact: identity, provenance, producing agent and run, service, domain, feature, repository, version, and the lineage linking it to the artifacts it derives from. Fields in the second tier accrue through use, and are what render the registry a learning system rather than a static index: which task types an artifact has served, which query intents retrieved it, which artifacts are consistently retrieved alongside it, and how often it was used rather than merely returned. Unknown fields are absent rather than null.
paragraphs.zh: 元数据注册表：稀疏、演化、学习：注册表为每个工件保存一条记录，分为两个层级，如表 1 所示。 创建时已知的字段是确定性的，随工件一同到达：身份、来源、产生它的智能体与运行、服务、领域、特征、仓库、版本，以及将它与其所派生工件相关联的谱系。 第二层级的字段在使用过程中累积，正是它们使注册表成为一个学习系统而非静态索引：工件服务过哪些任务类型、哪些查询意图检索过它、哪些工件总是与它一同被检索，以及它被实际使用的频率而不仅是被返回的频率。 未知字段是缺失而非空值。

sents.en: Fields in the second tier accrue through use, and are what render the registry a learning system rather than a static index: which task types an artifact has served, which query intents retrieved it, which artifacts are consistently retrieved alongside it, and how often it was used rather than merely returned.
sents.zh: 第二层级的字段在使用过程中累积，正是它们使注册表成为一个学习系统而非静态索引：工件服务过哪些任务类型、哪些查询意图检索过它、哪些工件总是与它一同被检索，以及它被实际使用的频率而不仅是被返回的频率。

sents.en: Unknown fields are absent rather than null.
sents.zh: 未知字段是缺失而非空值。

paragraphs.en: Navigation Hypergraph: The hypergraph supplies the navigation intelligence between intent recognition and vector retrieval. Its nodes group the artifacts describing a given feature of a given service; its edges are hyperedges connecting sets of nodes that participate in a shared workflow. Hyperedges rather than binary edges because the relationships are genuinely n n -ary: an order-submission workflow traversing ordering, catalog, and billing is one relation among three services, not three pairwise links (Figure 2 ). The structure reflects where the difficulty actually lies. Business entities recur throughout the estate: offer carries eligibility rules in the ordering service, validity rules in catalog, and discount rules in billing, and relating every occurrence of every such entity to every other is the congested graph that content-level ontology would require us to build and maintain. Scoping by service dissolves the problem instead of modeling it: a question about ordering rules is answered from ordering artifacts, and the catalog service’s offer rules are never candidates. The alias index maps business vocabulary onto node identifiers, resolving the terms a query uses to the nodes where the corresponding artifacts reside.
paragraphs.zh: 导航超图：该超图在意图识别与向量检索之间提供导航智能。 其节点将描述某一服务某一特征的制品分组；其边是连接参与同一工作流的节点集合的超边。 采用超边而非二元边，是因为这些关系本质上是 n 元的：一个遍历订购、目录和计费的订单提交工作流是三个服务之间的一个关系，而不是三个两两相连的链接（见图 2）。 这种结构反映了难点实际所在。 业务实体在整个系统中反复出现：offer 在订购服务中携带资格规则，在目录中携带有效性规则，在计费中携带折扣规则，而将每个此类实体的每次出现都相互关联起来，正是内容级本体要求我们构建和维护的那张拥塞图。 按服务划分范围消解了这个问题，而不是对其建模：关于订购规则的问题从订购制品中得到回答，目录服务的 offer 规则永远不会成为候选。 别名索引将业务词汇映射到节点标识符上，把查询所用的术语解析到对应制品所在的节点。

paragraphs.en: Identifier-Constrained Retrieval: Retrieval proceeds through five stages. (1) Intent classification. A lightweight model identifies question type, target service, and domain; no corpus content is accessed. (2) Hypergraph navigation. The alias index resolves query vocabulary to candidate nodes and the paths among them. (3) Candidate scoping. Those nodes return the identifiers of their constituent artifacts, ordinarily a small subset of the corpus. (4) Identifier-constrained search. Hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval is executed over the embeddings of that set alone. (5) Confidence gate. An LLM evaluates whether the scoped results are sufficient; where they are not, retrieval widens to the full corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符约束检索：检索分五个阶段进行。 （1）意图分类。 一个轻量级模型识别问题类型、目标服务和领域；不访问语料库内容。 （2）超图导航。 别名索引将查询词汇解析为候选节点及其之间的路径。（3）候选范围限定。 这些节点返回其组成制品的标识符，通常是语料库的一个小子集。 （4）标识符约束搜索。 混合密集检索与 BM25 检索仅在该集合的嵌入上执行。（5）置信度门控。 一个大语言模型评估范围限定的结果是否充分；若不充分，检索将扩展到整个语料库。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4 realizes the framework’s central claim, and the constraint merits precise statement. The filter is artifact identity, applied to the vector query itself, with the consequence that the similarity computation is never presented with the remainder of the corpus. The near-identical rule belonging to another service is thus absent from the candidate set rather than outranked within it . Disambiguation follows from how the corpus was organized rather than from how the scores happened to fall, and retrieval cost scales with the size of the scoped set rather than that of the estate. Figure 3 presents a worked trace.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 阶段实现了该框架的核心主张，这一约束值得精确表述。 过滤器是工件身份，直接应用于向量查询本身，其结果是相似度计算永远不会接触到语料库的其余部分。 因此，属于另一服务的近乎相同的规则是从候选集中缺席，而非在候选集中排名较低。 消歧源于语料库的组织方式，而非分数的偶然分布，且检索成本随作用域集合的大小而非整个资产库的规模扩展。 图 3 给出了一个完整的追踪示例。

paragraphs.en: The widening path constitutes the framework’s safety property. Any scoping mechanism may err through a misclassified intent, a missing alias, or a misplaced artifact, and a system that trusts its scope unconditionally fails silently. This design verifies rather than trusts, incurring the cost of a full-corpus search where scoping proves insufficient. Section Deployment and Evaluation returns to the widening rate, since a framework that widens on the majority of queries has an index that is not performing organizational work.
paragraphs.zh: 不断拓宽的路径构成了该框架的安全属性。 任何作用域机制都可能因意图分类错误、别名缺失或工件放错位置而出错，而无条件信任自身作用域的系统会静默失效。 这一设计采用验证而非信任的方式，在作用域机制被证明不足时承担全语料库搜索的代价。 部署与评估一节将回到拓宽率的问题，因为若框架在大多数查询上都发生拓宽，其索引便没有发挥组织性作用。

paragraphs.en: Every answer produces a runtime context graph recording the intent inferred, the nodes entered, the artifacts consulted, the chunks that contributed, and the provenance each chunk carries back to source. Conceived as a debugging instrument, it proved the single most significant factor in adoption. A developer presented with a proposed root cause is not obliged to trust the agent’s conclusion: the context graph identifies the requirements document, the business rule, and the source reference on which it rests, so that verification consists in following citations rather than in repeating the analysis. For the organization, it serves as an audit trail, in that the evidence path underlying any answer the system has produced remains recoverable.
paragraphs.zh: 每个答案都会生成一个运行时上下文图，记录所推断的意图、进入的节点、查阅的工件、做出贡献的分块，以及每个分块回溯到源的出处。 它最初被构想为一种调试工具，结果却成为推动采用的最关键因素。 面对一个由智能体提出的疑似根因，开发者并无义务盲目相信其结论：上下文图标明了结论所依据的需求文档、业务规则和源代码引用，因此验证工作就变成跟随引用进行核查，而不是重复整个分析过程。 对组织而言，它充当审计线索，即系统所产生的任何答案背后的证据路径都保持可追溯。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge layer is used in two modes. Practitioners query it conversationally, asking which rules govern a journey or how workflows connect components across services; this conversational access is the current form of the role-based serving described in Section Limitations, Path Forward, and Conclusion . SDLC agents query it programmatically as a retrieval substrate, of which defect analysis and release regression attribution are the two with the most operational history. We evaluate the framework on the cost of construction and extension, the acceptance of its output by practitioners, and retrieval accuracy, the last of which is under evaluation at the time of writing.
paragraphs.zh: 知识层以两种模式使用。 从业者以对话方式查询它，询问哪些规则支配某次旅程，或工作流如何在跨服务的组件之间建立连接；这种对话式访问即是「局限性、前进方向与结论」一节中所述的基于角色的服务的当前形式。 软件开发生命周期（SDLC）智能体以编程方式查询它，将其作为检索基座，其中缺陷分析和发布回归归因是运营历史最丰富的两种用途。 我们从构建与扩展的成本、从业者对其输出的接受度以及检索准确性三个方面评估该框架，其中检索准确性在撰写本文时仍在评估中。

paragraphs.en: Defect Root Cause and Resolution. The agent with the longest operational history takes a production ticket and produces a root cause and a proposed resolution, citing the rule, repository, and change site the fix requires. Its two generations differ in whether they had access to the knowledge layer. The first generation operated from issue-tracker history and runtime logs alone. Developers found its output insufficiently concrete, because logs indicate where behavior failed but not what the correct behavior was. Without the requirements specification, the agent could identify a fault but not the change required to correct it. The specification existed as the extracted artifacts, but the agent had no means of retrieving the relevant ones. The current agent combines evidence from the issue tracker and log platform, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ( Anthropic 2024 ) , with artifacts retrieved from the knowledge layer. More than 100 defects from the live production queue have been analyzed during defect-fix release cycles. Each analysis is reviewed by the developers who own the affected service, and accepted results are written back into the issue tracker.

Analysis required indicates that evidence was retrieved but a specific signal is absent, which the output names. Evidence blocked indicates an operational obstruction that prevented collection. paragraphs.en: Other Agents Using the Knowledge Layer. A separate agent analyzed 35 regression failures reported during feature releases, attributing each to a specific rule, journey, or service, and required no modification to the knowledge layer. A test coverage agent assesses the existing test suite against documented journeys and acceptance criteria. A coding agent, currently in development, retrieves the rules and journeys touching changed components and performs one-hop hyperedge expansion to identify dependent services. Requirement brainstorming and story breakdown agents provide analysts and architects with existing behavior before new work is specified. Practitioner access is provided through a command-line interface, a REST API, and a browser interface over the catalog, hypergraph, and stored context graphs.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval Behavior. Latency is addressed by the design rather than measured after the fact. Because the candidate set is narrowed before any similarity is computed, search cost scales with the scoped set rather than the corpus, and the artifacts are JSON and Markdown files that parse quickly. Retrieval is interactive in both conversational and agent use, and latency has not been an operational concern in deployment. The property under evaluation is accuracy: whether a query returns the rule governing the service in question rather than a near-identical rule from an adjacent one. Two measurements are in progress. The first is the widening rate, the fraction of queries on which the confidence gate falls back to the full corpus, which indicates how often scoping is sufficient. The second is an adjudicated comparison on ambiguity-weighted queries, which requires practitioners familiar with the services to label results.
paragraphs.zh: 检索行为。 延迟是通过设计来解决的，而不是事后才测量的。 由于候选集在任何相似度计算之前就被缩小，搜索成本随范围限定后的集合而非整个语料库扩展，且产物是解析速度快的 JSON 和 Markdown 文件。 检索在对话和智能体两种使用场景中都是交互式的，且在部署中延迟从未成为运行层面的问题。 被评估的属性是准确性：查询返回的是 governing 相关服务的规则，而不是来自相邻服务的近乎相同的规则。 目前正在进行两项测量。 第一项是回退率，即置信度门控回退到整个语料库的查询所占比例，它表明范围限定在多大程度上是足够的。 第二项是在歧义加权查询上进行的裁定性比较，这需要熟悉相关服务的从业者来标注结果。

paragraphs.en: Ontology engineering. The classical response to vocabulary divergence is to model the domain explicitly ( Gruber 1993 ) and to align vocabularies where they diverge ( Noy and Musen 2000 ) . That literature established both the value of shared conceptualization and its cost: alignment is semi-automatic at best, and the effort scales with the number of concepts requiring disambiguation. Our position is not that ontology is unnecessary but that its level is a design variable. We classify artifacts rather than the entities they contain, which is tractable to maintain at enterprise scale and which, on a machine-generated corpus, is supplied largely without cost by the producing agents.
paragraphs.zh: 本体工程。 针对词汇分歧的经典应对方法是对领域进行显式建模（Gruber 1993），并在词汇出现分歧之处进行对齐（Noy and Musen 2000）。 那批文献既确立了共享概念化的价值，也确立了其代价：对齐充其量只能半自动化，而且工作量随需要消歧的概念数量而扩展。 我们的立场并非本体不必要，而是其层级是一个设计变量。 我们对工件而非其所含实体进行分类，这在企业规模下是可维护的，并且在机器生成的语料库上，这种分类很大程度上由产生它们的智能体免费提供。

paragraphs.en: Graph-based retrieval. GraphRAG ( Edge et al. 2024 ) and LightRAG ( Guo et al. 2025 ) construct entity graphs from corpus text and traverse them at query time, with demonstrated gains in multi-hop reasoning. We employ neither, and our navigation structure is not an entity graph. A graph induced from colliding text inherits the collision: the extractor must determine whether occurrences of offer in the ordering and catalog services constitute one entity or two, which is the disambiguation problem itself. Our hypergraph is defined over artifacts and its nodes are fixed by provenance, so the question does not arise. Work on knowledge graphs for hallucination reduction ( Agrawal et al. 2024 ) is complementary; our framework produces the organized source such approaches would query.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的检索。 GraphRAG（Edge 等，2024）和 LightRAG（Guo 等，2025）从语料文本构建实体图，并在查询时进行遍历，在多跳推理上已展示出收益。 我们两者都不采用，我们的导航结构也不是实体图。 从冲突文本中归纳出的图会继承这种冲突：抽取器必须判断 ordering 服务和 catalog 服务中出现的 offer 是一个实体还是两个实体，而这本身就是消歧问题。 我们的超图定义于制品之上，其节点由来源固定，因此不会出现这一问题。 关于用知识图谱减少幻觉的工作（Agrawal 等，2024）与我们互补；我们的框架产出了这类方法可以查询的、经过组织的源。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent software engineering. Recovering design information from existing systems is a long-standing concern ( Chikofsky and Cross 1990 ) ; what has changed is that agents can now perform the recovery at estate scale. ChatDev ( Qian and others 2024 ) , MetaGPT ( Hong et al. 2024 ) , and SWE-agent ( Yang et al. 2024 ) demonstrate agent collaboration, role-based workflows, and iterative code interaction respectively, but each presumes that specifications or issue descriptions already exist as input. Industrial retrieval systems make the same presumption one layer up, including FAQ-first architectures for real-time decision support ( Agrawal et al. 2026b ) , which operate downstream of an organized knowledge source. Our upstream pipeline ( companion ) recovers specifications from undocumented systems; the present work addresses the organization problem that arises once they exist at scale. The two are complementary: one produces the knowledge, the other renders it usable.

paragraphs.en: The approach depends on a machine-generated corpus whose artifacts retain provenance. On heterogeneous human-authored material, classification would require inference from content, reintroducing the cost the design avoids; we claim no generality beyond that boundary. Within it, retrieval precision is bounded by placement quality, since a misplaced artifact makes its node incorrect for every query entering through it, and we do not yet measure placement precision independently of downstream outcomes. The framework also inherits the coverage of its upstream agents: behavior resolved only at runtime, rules held in stored procedures or routing configuration, and knowledge retained only in institutional memory are absent from the artifacts and therefore from retrieval. The deployment is a single estate, and its outcomes are adjudicated by practitioners familiar with the services in question, which is necessary for competent judgment and a possible source of optimism bias.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法依赖于一个机器生成的语料库，其中的制品保留了来源信息。 对于异构的人类撰写的材料，分类将需要从内容进行推断，重新引入该设计所避免的成本；我们不声称在该边界之外具有普适性。 在该语料库之内，检索精度受限于放置质量，因为一个放置不当的制品会使其节点对每一个经由它进入的查询都是错误的，而我们尚未独立于下游结果来度量放置精度。 该框架还继承了其上游智能体的覆盖范围：仅在运行时才确定的行为、保存在存储过程或路由配置中的规则，以及仅保留在机构记忆中的知识，都不在制品之中，因此也不在检索范围之内。 该部署是单一环境，其结果由熟悉相关服务的从业者裁定，这对于做出胜任的判断是必要的，但也可能是乐观偏差的一个来源。

paragraphs.en: The deployed system is intended as the substrate for a fuller layer that adds further agents over the same structure: a composition agent that assembles a knowledge set matched to a consumer’s role and required depth; a boundary agent that enforces domain, temporal, and confidence separation, so that legacy and target behavior are not combined; and a curation agent that promotes recurring observations into reusable patterns and flags stale artifacts. Each has a limited form in the deployed system, as service-level scoping, as the confidence gate, and as the write-back mechanism. The sequencing is deliberate: organizing at the artifact layer defers entity-level modeling until accumulated usage justifies it, rather than requiring it in advance. Nearer-term work follows the same principle, instrumenting retrieval quality per agent and re-ingesting on code change so the layer tracks a changing codebase. The design also admits brand as a further classification axis without structural change, should the estate extend to multiple brands.
paragraphs.zh: 已部署的系统旨在作为更完整一层的基底，在相同结构上增加更多智能体：一个组合智能体，根据消费者的角色和所需深度组装匹配的知识集；一个边界智能体，强制执行领域、时间与置信度上的分离，使遗留行为与目标行为不被混在一起；以及一个策展智能体，将反复出现的观察提炼为可复用的模式，并标记过时的制品。 三者在已部署系统中都有有限的形态，分别体现为服务级作用域、置信度门控和写回机制。 这一顺序是有意为之：在制品层进行组织，将实体级建模推迟到累积的使用足以证明其必要时，而不是要求事先完成。 近期的工作遵循同样的原则，按智能体监测检索质量，并在代码变更时重新摄取，使该层能够追踪不断变化的代码库。 该设计还允许在不做结构性改动的情况下，把品牌作为进一步的分类维度，以应对资产扩展到多个品牌的情况。

paragraphs.en: When enterprise knowledge is produced by agents rather than written by people, organizing it is a problem distinct from any single agent’s capability. Flat retrieval fails under vocabulary collision, and content-level ontology addresses it at a cost repaid at every release. KB Cataloging places the ontology at the artifact layer instead and constrains retrieval to artifact identifiers, so that a rule from an adjacent service is absent from the candidate set rather than outranked within it. Deployed on an estate of 241 repositories across 18 services, it serves production SDLC agents and practitioners directly, with more than 100 production defects analyzed and resolved under developer verification. The principle is general: when a corpus carries provenance, the structure required for precise retrieval already exists within it, and organizing on that structure performs the disambiguation that would otherwise require an ontology.
paragraphs.zh: 当企业知识由智能体产生而非由人工撰写时，对它进行组织就是一个不同于任何单个智能体能力的问题。 平坦式检索在词汇冲突下会失效，内容层本体可以解决这一问题，但代价需要在每次发布时不断偿付。 KB Cataloging 转而将本体置于工件层，并将检索约束在工件标识符上，使得来自相邻服务的规则直接不进入候选集合，而不是在候选集合内被排序靠后。 该方法部署于覆盖 18 个服务的 241 个仓库的环境中，直接服务于生产环境的 SDLC 智能体与从业者，在开发者核验下分析并解决了 100 多个生产缺陷。 该原则具有普适性：当语料库自带来源信息时，实现精确检索所需的结构已然存在于其中，基于该结构进行组织即可完成本需本体才能实现的消歧。
